instructions.value: In Observe trials, participants viewed angry or neutral faces attentively and allowed any emotional responses without manipulating them. In Increase trials, they imagined that the depicted person was associated and angry or upset with them because they had done something wrong. In Decrease trials, they imagined that the depicted person was unknown to them and merely having a bad day. After each trial, they rated their current emotional state from 1 (unpleasant/bad) to 8 (pleasant/well).
